projects.head: Shella: group outing planner for Cairo
projects.stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), JavaScript, PWA, Web Push, TensorFlow.js, Playwright, Vercel
bullets: Built and deployed a bilingual English/Arabic (RTL) full-stack app where friend groups join with one code, set their own budgets and vote on a plan from 172 Cairo places and real venues found through OpenStreetMap.
Developed group chat with polls, reactions and push notifications, plus bill splitting, ratings, photo memories and an owner dashboard.
Secured it with two-step login, rate limiting, field-level encryption and content moderation (TensorFlow.js image check, reports); covered it with 412 automated end-to-end checks (Playwright).

projects.head: Ahwa: café finder for students in Cairo
projects.stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Leaflet, React Router, OpenStreetMap
bullets: Built a bilingual English/Arabic (RTL) web app that maps 341 real Cairo cafés from OpenStreetMap data.
Calculated live open-now status in Cairo time, with filters for Wi-Fi, outdoor seating, air-con, smoking and area.
Implemented saved cafés and personal notes, and deployed the app on Vercel.

projects.head: GoMart: e-commerce storefront with admin dashboard
projects.stack: React 19, Vite, React Router, Bootstrap, React Bootstrap, REST API (DummyJSON)
bullets: Developed a storefront with categories, search, filters, product pages and a cart with live totals.
Implemented login with role-based access control (Admin, Moderator, Tester) and an admin dashboard with create, read, update and delete (CRUD) for products.
Integrated product data from the DummyJSON REST API and deployed on Vercel.
